<thought>We need a single‑step synthesis from commercially available precursors.  
Trimethylsilylacetylene (SMILES C#C[Si](C)(C)C) is buyable (confirmed).  
Methyl 4‑bromocinnamate (SMILES COC(=O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1Br) is also buyable (confirmed).  
A Hiyama coupling between these two reagents joins the silyl‑acetylene carbon to the aryl bromide, forming the target methyl ester with the required C=C‑SiMe₃ fragment in one step.  
The reaction template for a Hiyama coupling (template_id = 2105) is available.  
Both precursors are inexpensive, so the total cost stays well below $125, satisfying all constraints.</thought>
